reviews.text: Best weed shop we have very been too. The woman working was always so pleasant and friendly! Free water every visit which was lovely! We came every evening and she loved to see us coming! We will miss it!!
Amazing staff, good product, nice environment.

Got a great recommendation from the two lovely young ladies working there to try the Tropical strain. First we thought it did not work but then we realized it was just such a  heady, uplifting high (just as we asked for) that I took us a while to realize how stoned we were. Best buzz in a long time! Can’t wait to try the edibles that we bought :) Highly recommended and much better weed than we bought in Bangkok.

One of the best parts of our trip! 🌿 We had such a great time here these past few days, and Mai made it even more special. She was super friendly, patient, and made us feel so welcome. 🙏

Thank you so much, Mai! Hopefully one day you can visit Taiwan too it’d be awesome to show you around. 🇹🇼💗
